assertions.name: second-terminal-pane-exists
assertions.evidence: Splits section: 'cmux new-split right — adds a right split in current workspace'. Creates actual pane, not a description.

assertions.name: new-pane-is-usable-immediately
assertions.evidence: After new-split, pane is in shell-ready state. 'cmux send --surface surface:3 cmd\n' can be used immediately to run commands.

assertions.name: original-workspace-remains-readable
assertions.evidence: Splitting creates a new surface alongside the existing one — the original pane remains the current context.

assertions.name: command-lands-on-requested-surface
assertions.evidence: Send Commands section: 'cmux send --surface surface:3 cmd\n' — --surface flag targets the exact requested pane.

assertions.name: execution-is-triggered
assertions.evidence: Note: '\n at end of send = auto-press Enter to run'. The send command triggers execution directly.

assertions.name: result-can-be-observed-from-pane
assertions.evidence: The pane is a visible split in the terminal. Operator can directly observe command output in the target surface.

assertions.name: non-cmux-state-is-detected
assertions.evidence: Detect cmux section: 'if ! command -v cmux &>/dev/null || ! cmux identify --json &>/dev/null; then ...' — checks both binary and session state.

assertions.name: broken-cmux-commands-are-not-emitted
assertions.evidence: Detection block exits with 'exit 0' before any cmux commands can execute when not in cmux.

assertions.name: fallback-or-clear-message-is-given
assertions.evidence: Detection block: 'echo Not in cmux — skipping cmux operations' provides a clear skip message to the operator.
